description: Returns complete numeric histories as compact CSV (t,value) from this service's archive of openly licensed series, e.g. ECB FX rates since 1999 (fx.EUR.USD), World Bank indicators for all countries since 1960 (wb.FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG.DE), ECB rates and 10y yields (ecb.rate.deposit, ecb.yield10y.IT), Eurostat, Statistics Canada, ONS and FAO series, German power prices (smard.price.day), sunspots since 1749 (noaa.sunspot-number). Pass q to search series ids, or id to fetch one (max 1,000 points, most recent kept). When to use: for many periods of one number (e.g. yearly inflation since 2000, monthly FX since 2010), with from/to and resample. For the latest value with context use ask_anything; get_history only holds values this service recorded from live endpoints. Read-only, no API key or signup. Free quota: 1000 calls/day per IP, shared across tools.

id.description: Series id to fetch, e.g. fx.EUR.USD

q.description: Search series by keywords, e.g. "inflation germany" (returns ids, no data)

to.description: End, inclusive: year (2025 = through Dec 31), month or date

name: get_series
title: Get a full time series
